name: TRDEFI Liquidity
description: Read-only agent for a live, non-custodial liquidity catalogue. Ask it for aggregate liquidity statistics, the open maker positions across 20 networks, the live networks, or an on-chain swap quote against a position. No key, and nothing it can do moves a token.

skills.name: Catalogue statistics
skills.description: Aggregate counts and realised settled volume for the open non-custodial liquidity catalogue, over 1, 7 and 30 days.

skills.name: Open positions
skills.description: The open maker positions, each with its network, pair and 32-byte strategy hash. Stablecoin pairs (USDC/USDT) are the core; the catalogue also carries other pairs.

skills.name: On-chain swap quote
skills.description: Quote a USDC/USDT swap against one position at the current block. Send `quote <strategyHash> <amountBaseUnits> [chain]`. A maker may gate a position; those answer with a reason instead of a price.
